prompt:
Create one photorealistic editorial food photograph for a clean modern meal-planning app. Landscape 4:3 composition, close three-quarter overhead camera, warm ivory speckled ceramic dish on a pale warm stone tabletop, natural soft window light, warm accurate colors, appetizing real home-cooked textures. Center the food with room for a square or portrait center crop. Only the listed recipe ingredients may appear as food. No invented toppings or side dishes, no herbs, cheese, lemon, lime, bread or garnish unless explicitly listed. No hands, cutlery, people, text, logos, labels, watermark or interface. One finished meal in one dish, no collage. Match a quiet consistent food-photo series.

Meal: breakfast burritos.
One soft tortilla breakfast burrito sliced diagonally into two halves, showing a clear cross-section of scrambled eggs, cooked black beans, red salsa and diced onion. Olive oil and salt only. No cheese, rice, avocado, herbs or garnish.
